_note: Light combo v3 (Nov 14, melee pass). Three distinct arcs that hand off: L1 forehand diagonal (high right to low left), L2 back-hand flat (left to right, starts where L1 ends), L3 overhead finisher (starts where L2 ends). Coil 0.05 s (torso turned against the cut), contact at 0.10 s (the code's HitDelay), follow-through 30-40 deg past centre by 0.18 s, recovery held to the lockout (0.28 / 0.28 / 0.36 s) so a chained press starts from the same pose, then back to the guard. hand = (forward, right, up) cm from the right shoulder in the chest frame; blade = direction in that frame; yaw = torso turn (deg, + = to the right); t = game seconds at the code's rate. Light2 is authored on Light1's legs (square stance): Light2's own legs stand side-on and turned the whole body 90 deg between the first and second hit in game (r1).
